evidence: package-lists-refresh-on-every-agent-run: packages_base.pp:11-19 declares class { 'apt': update => { frequency => 'always' } } on non-RedHat, so Exec[apt_update] runs on every agent run; the probe counts its 'changed: true' in the last run report (harness run 2) and expects 1, which is what the line produces

the-tools-work: packages_base.pp:43-46 installs $package_list (lines 26-27: monitoring-plugins-standard, acl, ecryptfs-utils, aptitude, ...); the probe runs check_disk from monitoring-plugins-standard, getfacl from acl and finds ecryptfs-setup-private and aptitude on the path, all from packages on that list

supervisor-cloud-init-and-unattended-upgrades-are-removed: packages_base.pp:59-61 (unattended_upgrades false, Debian) declares package unattended-upgrades ensure absent, with line 51 removing supervisor and cloud-init; under the defaults fixture the probe expects all three not installed, and its case pattern ' installed' does not match 'not-installed' or 'config-files'
